scope: All 82 remaining glossary names in eight target languages; definitions, examples and cautions remain pending. No translated full-text route is authorized by this file.

source.name: Torque rise / torque reserve
source.definition: A percentage describing how much torque can increase as engine speed drops under load.
source.example: It may affect how the engine responds when a plough meets tougher soil.
source.caution: Manufacturers may calculate it using different reference speeds.

names.fr: Réserve de couple / hausse de couple
names.es: Reserva de par / aumento del par
names.pt-br: Reserva de torque / aumento de torque
names.ja: トルク上昇率・トルク予備力

source.name: Engine displacement (cc / L)
source.definition: The total volume swept by the pistons; 3,000 cc is about 3.0 litres.
source.example: Two engines of the same displacement can produce different outputs.
source.caution: A larger engine is not automatically more capable or more fuel-efficient.

source.name: Number of cylinders
source.definition: The number of piston cylinders, influencing size, smoothness and engine character.
source.example: A three-cylinder and a four-cylinder model may feel and weigh differently.
source.caution: Cylinder count alone does not prove reliability or output.

source.name: Bore and stroke
source.definition: Bore is cylinder diameter; stroke is piston travel between dead centres.
source.example: A specification of '110 × 116 mm' denotes these two dimensions.
source.caution: If calculated displacement conflicts with the listed volume, flag the inconsistency.

source.name: Engine speed (rpm)
source.definition: Crankshaft revolutions per minute; engine rpm is not the same as PTO rpm.
source.example: A 540 rpm PTO setting can require a different engine rpm.
source.caution: Check the rpm attached to peak power and torque figures.

source.name: Turbocharger and intercooler
source.definition: A turbo uses exhaust energy to compress intake air; an intercooler cools the compressed charge.
source.example: A smaller turbocharged engine can deliver substantial output.
source.caution: A turbo alone guarantees neither fuel economy nor service life.

names.ja: ターボチャージャーとインタークーラー

source.name: Common rail / fuel injection
source.definition: The system that meters and injects fuel at controlled pressure and timing.
source.example: Electronic injection helps control combustion across loads.
source.caution: Injection pressure is not itself a power or reliability score.

names.ja: コモンレール・燃料噴射

source.name: Emissions standard (Stage / Tier)
source.definition: Exhaust-emission limits that apply to a market and regulatory period.
source.example: Stage V and older Stage IIIA refer to different regulatory regimes.
source.caution: The same model name may have different emissions equipment by market.

source.name: DPF, SCR and AdBlue/DEF
source.definition: DPF traps soot particles; SCR uses a dosing fluid to reduce nitrogen oxides.
source.example: A tractor with DEF has a separate tank; it must not go into the diesel tank.
source.caution: Not every emissions class mandates identical hardware; consult the model manual.

source.name: Manual transmission
source.definition: Gear ratios are selected mechanically; clutch operation depends on the design.
source.example: 12F/12R means 12 forward and 12 reverse ratios.
source.caution: Gear count alone does not establish comfort or durability.

source.name: Powershift transmission
source.definition: A gearbox allowing some ratio changes under load without clutch-pedal operation.
source.example: It can make speed adjustments easier while working.
source.caution: Partial powershift is not the same as full-range powershift.

source.name: CVT / continuously variable transmission
source.definition: Continuously varies drive ratio over an operating range.
source.example: It may maintain a chosen field speed while adjusting engine rpm.
source.caution: Not all CVTs share the same operating principle, efficiency or maintenance needs.

source.name: HST / hydrostatic transmission
source.definition: A driveline using a hydraulic pump and motor to vary ground speed smoothly.
source.example: It is useful during repeated loader manoeuvres.
source.caution: Hydrostatic drive is not the same as auxiliary implement hydraulics.

source.name: Shuttle / reverser
source.definition: The control or mechanism used to select forward and reverse travel.
source.example: It eases frequent direction changes during bale handling.
source.caution: Mechanical, synchronized and electrohydraulic reversers differ.

names.ja: 前後進切替装置（リバーサー）

source.name: Clutch and dual clutch
source.definition: Connects or disconnects drive; two-stage designs may separate PTO engagement from travel.
source.example: On some tractors a second pedal stage controls PTO drive.
source.caution: Dual clutch does not necessarily mean a car-style DCT gearbox.

names.ja: クラッチとダブルクラッチ

source.name: 2WD and 4WD drive
source.definition: Indicates whether two or four wheels can contribute driven traction.
source.example: 4WD may reduce slip on wet soil; 2WD may suffice on firm ground.
source.caution: Tyres, weight and soil matter; 4WD is not universally superior.

names.es: Tracción a dos y cuatro ruedas (2WD/4WD)
names.pt-br: Tração em duas e quatro rodas (2WD/4WD)

source.name: Differential lock
source.definition: Limits differential wheel-speed difference to help traction on slippery ground.
source.example: It can help maintain grip when one wheel is slipping on wet ground.
source.caution: Follow turning and hard-surface instructions; do not use it indiscriminately.

source.name: Final drive, axle and 4x4 differential
source.definition: Final gearing and axle components transmit driveline torque to the wheels.
source.example: Portal and planetary arrangements can affect clearance and torque reduction.
source.caution: Axle type alone does not establish durability or traction.

names.zh: 终传动、车桥与 4x4 差速器
names.ja: 最終減速機・車軸・4x4デファレンシャル

source.name: Ground-speed PTO
source.definition: A PTO mode tied to the tractor’s ground travel.
source.example: Certain implements require rotation tied to travel speed.
source.caution: It is not interchangeable with a standard 540 rpm mode.

names.fr: Prise de force proportionnelle à l’avancement

source.name: Front PTO
source.definition: A PTO outlet at the front for front-mounted implements.
source.example: It can enable front and rear implements to work together.
source.caution: Often optional; front linkage and power ratings also matter.

source.name: Three-point linkage
source.definition: An implement attachment arrangement using two lower links and a top link.
source.example: It positions ploughs, drills and rotary tillers relative to the tractor.
source.caution: Link geometry, category and implement centre of gravity matter as much as lift rating.

source.name: EHR / electronic hitch control
source.definition: Electronic control of linkage position or draft response.
source.example: It may help return an implement to a repeatable headland height.
source.caution: Sensor design and control features vary by model.

source.name: Draft control / position control
source.definition: Draft control reacts to implement resistance; position control targets linkage position.
source.example: Draft control can matter for ploughing; position control for grading.
source.caution: It still requires proper soil and implement setup.

names.ja: ドラフト制御・位置制御

source.name: Front linkage
source.definition: An implement mounting and lifting arrangement at the tractor front.
source.example: It can carry a front mower or implement instead of a simple weight.
source.caution: Front PTO, lifting capacity and front axle limits must be checked separately.

source.name: Open-centre and closed-centre hydraulics
source.definition: Circuit architectures describing how pump and valves handle flow when no function is demanded.
source.example: Variable-displacement systems can adjust delivered flow to demand.
source.caution: Open/closed-centre labels alone do not determine implement performance.

names.fr: Hydraulique à centre ouvert et fermé
names.es: Hidráulica de centro abierto y cerrado
names.pt-br: Hidráulica de centro aberto e fechado
names.zh: 开中心与闭中心液压系统
names.ru: Гидросистемы с открытым и закрытым центром
names.ja: オープンセンター・クローズドセンター油圧

source.name: Wheelbase
source.definition: Longitudinal distance between front and rear axle centres.
source.example: A shorter wheelbase may help manoeuvring in tight spaces.
source.caution: Turning radius depends on more than wheelbase.

source.name: Track width
source.definition: Distance between the centres of the left and right wheels on one axle.
source.example: Adjustable track width matters for row crops.
source.caution: Overall width is not the same as wheel-centre track width.

source.name: Ground clearance
source.definition: The distance from the ground to the specified lowest underside point.
source.example: It matters for clearance over crops and obstacles.
source.caution: Tyre size and measurement point alter the result.

source.name: Overall length, width and height
source.definition: The exterior length, width and height of the tractor in a stated configuration.
source.example: They determine whether the tractor fits a greenhouse door or vineyard row.
source.caution: They can vary with cab, ROPS, ballast and tyre configuration.

names.fr: Longueur, largeur et hauteur hors tout

source.name: Unladen and operating weight
source.definition: Different mass definitions according to fluids, driver and fitted equipment.
source.example: A cab variant can weigh more than an open-station model.
source.caution: Shipping, dry and operating weights must not be treated as identical.

names.fr: Masse à vide et masse en ordre de marche
names.es: Peso en vacío y en orden de marcha
names.pt-br: Peso sem carga e peso operacional
names.ru: Масса без нагрузки и эксплуатационная масса
names.ja: 空車重量・運転時重量

source.name: Ballast / front weights
source.definition: Additional weight used for traction and balance.
source.example: A heavy rear implement may require suitable front ballast.
source.caution: Excess ballast increases soil compaction and axle load.

names.ja: バラスト・前部ウエイト

source.name: Tyre size
source.definition: Defines tyre section, construction and rim size.
source.example: 13.6-28 and 14.9-28 tyres are different nominal sizes.
source.caution: Front/rear rolling circumference matters on 4WD; substitutions need approval.

source.name: Tyre inflation and soil pressure
source.definition: Inflation pressure affects tyre behaviour and, with load, soil contact stress.
source.example: Load-appropriate pressure affects traction and soil imprint.
source.caution: Do not recommend inflation without the tyre maker’s load/speed tables.

names.fr: Pression de gonflage et pression au sol
names.es: Presión de inflado y sobre el suelo
names.pt-br: Pressão de inflação e pressão sobre o solo
names.zh: 轮胎充气压力与土壤接触压力
names.hi: टायर वायु दबाव और मिट्टी पर दबाव
names.ru: Давление в шинах и давление на почву
names.ja: タイヤ空気圧と接地圧

source.name: Turning radius
source.definition: The geometric radius of a turn at full steering lock.
source.example: It indicates how easily the tractor can turn around in confined yards or at field edges.
source.caution: Tyres, 4WD, brake assistance and test method affect the figure.

source.name: Drawbar and drawbar power
source.definition: The drawbar connects a towed load; drawbar power is useful work delivered to the pull.
source.example: An attached trailer still must meet braking and permitted mass limits.
source.caution: Engine, PTO and drawbar power are different measurements.

names.fr: Barre de traction et puissance à la barre
names.es: Barra de tiro y potencia de tiro
names.pt-br: Barra de tração e potência na barra
names.ja: ドローバーとけん引出力

source.name: Permitted axle load and gross mass
source.definition: Manufacturer limits for axle loads and total machine mass.
source.example: Check axle limits when combining a loader and ballast.
source.caution: Lift rating does not override the permitted mass limits.

names.fr: Charge admissible par essieu et masse totale
names.es: Carga admisible por eje y masa total
names.pt-br: Carga admissível por eixo e massa total
names.hi: अनुमत एक्सल भार और कुल द्रव्यमान
names.ru: Допустимая нагрузка на ось и полная масса

source.name: ROPS / rollover protection
source.definition: A tested protective structure intended to maintain operator clearance in a rollover.
source.example: On open-station tractors, ROPS and a seat belt work together.
source.caution: ROPS alone does not make unbelted driving safe; follow foldable-ROPS instructions.

source.name: FOPS / falling-object protection
source.definition: A structure designed to protect from specified falling-object hazards.
source.example: Forestry and loader tasks can create distinct protection needs.
source.caution: ROPS and FOPS are not the same certification.

names.fr: FOPS / protection contre les chutes d’objets
names.es: FOPS / protección contra caída de objetos
names.pt-br: FOPS / proteção contra queda de objetos

source.name: Dry and wet disc brakes
source.definition: Brake designs with friction components operating dry or in oil.
source.example: A wet-disc system can manage heat and wear differently.
source.caution: Stopping distance also depends on tyres, loading, surface and maintenance.

names.fr: Freins à disques secs et immergés
names.es: Frenos de disco secos y húmedos
names.pt-br: Freios a disco secos e banhados a óleo
names.zh: 干式与湿式盘式制动器
names.ja: 乾式・湿式ディスクブレーキ

source.name: Seat belt and operator seat
source.definition: Equipment intended to retain the operator and reduce transmitted vibration.
source.example: Proper belt use is essential to benefit from rollover protection.
source.caution: Follow the machine manual and local safety requirements.

names.fr: Ceinture de sécurité et siège opérateur
names.es: Cinturón de seguridad y asiento del operador
names.pt-br: Cinto de segurança e assento do operador
names.ja: シートベルトと運転席

source.name: Hydrostatic / power steering
source.definition: Steering systems assisted by hydraulic power.
source.example: Low-speed loader manoeuvres can be easier.
source.caution: Power steering is not the same as an HST drive gearbox.

names.ja: 油圧式ステアリング・パワーステアリング

source.name: Cab filtration and air conditioning
source.definition: Equipment for operator comfort and, where specified, air filtration.
source.example: Filter care matters in dusty operations.
source.caution: A normal cab filter is not certified pesticide protection.

names.es: Filtración de cabina y aire acondicionado
names.ja: キャビン空気ろ過とエアコン

source.name: Noise and vibration
source.definition: Noise and vibration levels to which an operator may be exposed.
source.example: Cab, seat and hearing protection can matter on long shifts.
source.caution: Do not rank machines from dB(A) figures without test location and standard.

source.name: Fuel tank capacity
source.definition: Amount of fuel a tank holds; not a measure of consumption or range.
source.example: An 80-litre tank does not promise a fixed number of hours.
source.caution: Consumption varies with load, speed and operating conditions.

source.name: Service interval
source.definition: A prescribed operating-hour or calendar interval for maintenance.
source.example: Engine oil and hydraulic fluid may have different intervals.
source.caution: Severe dusty operation may require shorter intervals.

source.name: Air, fuel and oil filters
source.definition: Service parts that limit contaminants reaching the engine or fluid circuits.
source.example: A restricted air filter can affect engine performance.
source.caution: Use model-approved filters and maintenance intervals.

names.fr: Filtres à air, à carburant et à huile
names.es: Filtros de aire, combustible y aceite
names.pt-br: Filtros de ar, combustível e óleo
names.zh: 空气、燃油与机油滤清器
names.ja: エア・燃料・オイルフィルター

source.name: ECE R120, ISO 14396 and OECD tests
source.definition: Engine standards describe declared power conditions; OECD codes define tractor testing procedures.
source.example: Do not compare an engine declaration with a Nebraska PTO test as the same metric.
source.caution: Always name the test point, year, procedure and measurement standard.

names.fr: ECE R120, ISO 14396 et essais OCDE
names.es: ECE R120, ISO 14396 y ensayos OCDE
names.pt-br: ECE R120, ISO 14396 e ensaios OCDE
names.zh: ECE R120、ISO 14396 与 OECD 试验
names.hi: ECE R120, ISO 14396 और OECD परीक्षण
names.ru: ECE R120, ISO 14396 и испытания ОЭСР

source.name: Manufacturer brochure vs independent test
source.definition: A brochure records a maker's claim; an independent test reports measurements under stated conditions.
source.example: An estimated catalogue PTO figure is not the same as a laboratory PTO test.
source.caution: Do not label undocumented values as verified or independently tested.

names.es: Catálogo del fabricante y ensayo independiente
names.pt-br: Catálogo do fabricante e ensaio independente
names.zh: 制造商样本与独立试验
names.hi: निर्माता की विवरणिका और स्वतंत्र परीक्षण
names.ja: メーカー資料と独立試験

source.name: Standard, optional and market variants
source.definition: Distinguishes base equipment, optional packages and regional configurations.
source.example: A US HST version may differ from a European manual version of the same name.
source.caution: Do not imply every listed option is fitted to one tractor.

names.fr: Équipement de série, options et variantes de marché
names.es: Equipamiento de serie, opcional y variantes de mercado
names.pt-br: Equipamentos de série, opcionais e versões de mercado
names.zh: 标准配置、选装与市场变型
names.ru: Стандартное оборудование, опции и рыночные версии
names.ja: 標準装備・オプション・市場別仕様

source.name: Engine manufacturer
source.definition: The company that makes or brands the engine; it may differ from the tractor manufacturer.
source.example: A tractor series can use one engine supplier in one generation and another later.
source.caution: The brand alone is not a parts identifier; confirm the engine model code.

source.name: Engine model or code
source.definition: A manufacturer identifier for a particular engine design or version.
source.example: For maintenance, an engine code can distinguish generations of the same tractor name.
source.caution: An engine code can change with the emissions stage or target market.

names.ja: エンジン型式・コード

source.name: Number of engine valves
source.definition: The number of valves controlling intake and exhaust flow through the cylinders.
source.example: A four-cylinder 16-valve engine may have four valves per cylinder.
source.caution: Valve count alone does not establish greater torque or engine longevity.

source.name: Cooling system and radiator
source.definition: The radiator dissipates heat from coolant; a circulation pump moves it through the engine.
source.example: If temperature rises under load, radiator cleanliness and fan operation matter.
source.caution: Never open a pressurised hot cooling system; follow the manual.

names.ja: 冷却装置とラジエーター

source.name: Engine air cleaner
source.definition: Filters dusty intake air to reduce abrasive contamination of pistons and cylinders.
source.example: During dusty harvest work, filter inspection may become more frequent.
source.caution: Dry-element and oil-bath filters require different service procedures.

names.ja: エンジンエアクリーナー

source.name: Diesel and fuel type
source.definition: The fuel the engine is designed to use; compatibility with its injection system matters.
source.example: Diesel and DEF go into separate tanks; DEF is not a fuel additive.
source.caution: Check the maker's permitted biodiesel blends for the exact version.

names.ja: ディーゼルと燃料の種類

source.name: Piston and rings
source.definition: The piston converts combustion pressure into motion; rings help seal the cylinder and control oil.
source.example: Worn rings can increase oil consumption or cause loss of compression.
source.caution: Smoke colour alone is not a diagnosis; proper testing is needed.

names.ja: ピストンとピストンリング

source.name: Crankshaft
source.definition: Converts piston reciprocating motion into rotation and delivers engine output.
source.example: Engine rpm is fundamentally crankshaft rotation speed.
source.caution: The crankshaft and PTO shaft are different, connected through the driveline.

source.name: Gross and net engine power
source.definition: Gross and net engine figures can differ according to test configuration and auxiliary equipment.
source.example: The same 75 kW figure can represent different test configurations.
source.caution: Gross, rated, PTO and boosted power must not be substituted for each other.

names.es: Potencia bruta y neta del motor
names.pt-br: Potência bruta e líquida do motor
names.zh: 发动机总功率与净功率
names.ja: エンジン総出力と正味出力

source.name: Road speed and minimum working speed
source.definition: The range of ground speeds available from gearbox and tyres.
source.example: Creeper gears can be useful for very slow implement operations.
source.caution: Top road speed does not override road regulations or equipment limits.

names.fr: Vitesse routière et vitesse minimale de travail
names.es: Velocidad en carretera y velocidad mínima de trabajo
names.pt-br: Velocidade rodoviária e velocidade mínima de trabalho
names.zh: 道路行驶速度与最低作业速度
names.hi: सड़क गति और न्यूनतम कार्य गति
names.ja: 路上走行速度と最低作業速度

source.name: Front axle suspension
source.definition: Helps absorb front-axle movement, influencing ride comfort and wheel contact.
source.example: It can improve ride comfort while transporting a trailer on uneven roads.
source.caution: Front axle suspension and cab suspension are different systems.

names.ja: フロントアクスルサスペンション

source.name: Gear range, creeper and powershift step
source.definition: Additional speed ranges or under-load shiftable steps layered onto main gears.
source.example: A 24F/24R gearbox may combine twelve gears with two ranges.
source.caution: A gear count alone does not prove full powershift operation.

names.es: Gama de marchas, superreductora y escalón Powershift
names.pt-br: Gama de marchas, super-redutor e estágio Powershift
names.zh: 挡位范围、爬行挡与动力换挡级
names.hi: गियर रेंज, क्रीपर और पावरशिफ्ट चरण
names.ru: Диапазон передач, ходоуменьшитель и ступень Powershift
names.ja: 変速レンジ・クリープギア・パワーシフト段

source.name: PTO clutch and engagement
source.definition: The clutching arrangement that engages or disconnects drive to the PTO shaft.
source.example: Electrohydraulic engagement can make PTO start-up smoother.
source.caution: Do not approach an implement while it is still coasting after disengagement.

names.fr: Embrayage et engagement de la PDF
names.es: Embrague y acoplamiento de la TDF

source.name: PTO shaft guard
source.definition: Guarding intended to reduce accidental contact with the rotating PTO shaft and joints.
source.example: Check that the shield is intact and correctly fitted when connecting implements.
source.caution: Never service a running PTO with missing guards; stop the engine.

source.name: Hydraulic pump
source.definition: Uses mechanical input to move hydraulic oil through the circuit.
source.example: Implement response speed depends on the pump and valve arrangement.
source.caution: Do not assume all stated pump flows are available at the rear couplers.

source.name: Hydraulic cylinder
source.definition: An actuator converting hydraulic pressure into linear pushing or pulling motion.
source.example: Loader lift and bucket-tilt cylinders serve different functions.
source.caution: Pressure, cylinder size and relief valves matter alongside flow.

source.name: Steering pump flow
source.definition: Oil flow supplied to the power steering circuit.
source.example: A combined 45 L/min figure does not mean all of it reaches an implement.
source.caution: Keep steering flow and implement-available flow as distinct figures.

names.fr: Débit de la pompe de direction
names.es: Caudal de la bomba de dirección
names.ja: ステアリングポンプ流量

source.name: Implement pump flow
source.definition: The stated flow available to implement or linkage functions.
source.example: Implement-available flow matters more than combined pump output for hydraulic motors.
source.caution: Confirm flow at the actual coupler and under the stated test conditions.

names.fr: Débit de la pompe des outils
names.es: Caudal de la bomba de implementos

source.name: Agricultural, turf and industrial tyres
source.definition: Tread pattern and construction influence traction and ground impact.
source.example: Turf tyres may be selected to reduce marking on grass.
source.caution: Never substitute tyre types without approved size and load compatibility.

names.es: Neumáticos agrícolas, de césped e industriales
names.pt-br: Pneus agrícolas, de gramado e industriais
names.ja: 農業用・芝用・産業用タイヤ

source.name: Adjustable wheel track
source.definition: Adjustment of wheel spacing within an approved range using rims or axles.
source.example: Track can be set to suit different crop row spacings.
source.caution: Incorrect rim mounting or axle loading can create safety risks.

source.name: Cab suspension
source.definition: Springs and dampers designed to reduce vibration passed from chassis to cab.
source.example: It can affect operator fatigue during long transport jobs.
source.caution: Seat, axle and cab suspension are separate options.

names.ja: キャビンサスペンション

source.name: Operator platform and cab structure
source.definition: The area housing operator seat, foot space and operating controls.
source.example: Flat floors, transmission tunnels and cabs differ in ergonomics.
source.caution: A cab alone is not proof of ROPS or FOPS certification.

names.fr: Plateforme opérateur et structure de cabine
names.es: Plataforma del operador y estructura de cabina
names.pt-br: Plataforma do operador e estrutura da cabine
names.zh: 驾驶平台与驾驶室结构
names.ja: 運転者プラットフォームとキャビン構造

source.name: Battery capacity (Ah)
source.definition: A rating for battery charge storage used for starting and electrical systems.
source.example: An 80 Ah and a 100 Ah battery may have different cranking capability.
source.caution: Amp-hours and cold-cranking amps are different specifications.

source.name: Alternator output (A)
source.definition: The engine-driven generator supplying electrical loads and charging the battery.
source.example: Extra lights and electronic devices increase electrical demand.
source.caution: Rated amps may only be available at specified engine speed.

names.ja: オルタネーター出力電流（A）

source.name: ISOBUS tractor-implement communication
source.definition: A standardised communication family allowing compatible tractors and implements to exchange data and controls.
source.example: A compatible drill can exchange setup and work data through a display.
source.caution: An ISOBUS socket does not guarantee every function works with every implement.

names.zh: ISOBUS 拖拉机与机具通信
names.ja: ISOBUSによるトラクター・作業機通信

source.name: GNSS guidance and autosteer
source.definition: Satellite-based systems that display guidance lines or steer compatible tractors.
source.example: It can help reduce pass overlap during precision fieldwork.
source.caution: Accuracy depends on correction service, receiver and application.

names.ja: GNSSガイダンスと自動操舵

source.name: Engine operating type
source.definition: Describes basic engine operation, such as diesel or petrol, four-stroke or two-stroke and cooling method.
source.example: A four-stroke diesel engine completes a power cycle over two crankshaft revolutions.
source.caution: Engine type is not the same field as its model code or rated horsepower.

source.name: External rear-linkage controls
source.definition: Controls that permit rear linkage positioning from outside the cab under prescribed conditions.
source.example: Fender-mounted lift buttons may ease positioning when coupling an implement.
source.caution: Never stand in a crush zone between tractor and implement; follow safe procedures.

names.ja: 後部リンク外部操作装置

source.name: Engine oil capacity
source.definition: The prescribed oil fill for the sump and lubrication system, critical to wear and heat management.
source.example: An 11-litre engine oil fill is not an 11-litre fuel-consumption figure.
source.caution: Fill quantity can differ with filter changes and engine versions; check the dipstick.

source.name: Cab glass area, visibility and volume
source.definition: Separate design measures describing all-round visibility and the operator's enclosure.
source.example: Good sight lines help loader operators see loads and people nearby.
source.caution: Glass area alone does not measure blind spots, sound insulation or safety certification.

source.definition: Identifiers used to distinguish product families, generations, engines or target markets.
source.example: A model name can cover distinct US and European transmissions.

source.definition: Mechanical or hydraulic provisions intended to limit unwanted implement movement during transport or parking.
source.example: A folding mower may require a transport lock before road travel.

source.definition: Electrical features that help clear mist or ice from mirrors and windows in cold, damp weather.
